knobs.name: caseT0
knobs.what: s: film time at which the agents stack-city clock starts (CASE t0)

knobs.name: caseT1
knobs.what: s: film time at which the agents stack-city clock ends; beats are fractions of caseT1 - caseT0

knobs.name: arrive0
knobs.what: s: the first agent boxes start to land in the pooled wall

knobs.name: arrive1
knobs.what: s: the last agent has landed (count 5,179 is read at 22.0)

knobs.name: lit0
knobs.what: s: the pooled wall starts to light bottom-up (lit height = average gain)

knobs.name: lit1
knobs.what: s: the pooled wall is lit (the ratio pin lands at poolPin)

knobs.name: move0
knobs.what: s: the boxes leave the pooled wall for the five skill fifths (M1 starts)

knobs.name: move1
knobs.what: s: the last box is in its fifth

knobs.name: turn0
knobs.what: s: the camera starts its turn (keep equal to move0: turn and re-partition are one gesture)

knobs.name: turn1
knobs.what: s: the camera arrives at the split view

knobs.name: devT0
knobs.what: s: film time at which the developers stack-city clock starts

knobs.name: devT1
knobs.what: s: film time at which the developers clock ends

knobs.name: devArrive0
knobs.what: s: the first developer boxes land

knobs.name: devArrive1
knobs.what: s: the last developer has landed (count 4,867 is read at 84.0)

knobs.name: devLit0
knobs.what: s: the developers wall starts to light bottom-up

knobs.name: devLit1
knobs.what: s: the developers wall is lit (ratio pin at devPin)

knobs.name: cutD
knobs.what: s: hard cut to the second field (developers)

knobs.name: cutM
knobs.what: s: hard cut to the third field (METR)

knobs.name: cutB
knobs.what: s: hard cut back to the pooled wall (MONDAY bookend)

knobs.name: bookT
knobs.what: s: which pooled moment of the agents clock the bookend shows (after the lit beat, before move0)

knobs.name: hookPush0
knobs.what: s: the wide hook frame starts a slow push to the case frame (no move before 8 s)

knobs.name: hookPush1
knobs.what: s: the push ends

knobs.name: hookOutline0
knobs.what: s: the outline of the column starts to rise behind the lone box

knobs.name: hookOutline1
knobs.what: s: the outline is full height

knobs.name: aiAt
knobs.what: s: the word AI appears over the outline (no digit in the hook)

knobs.name: look0
knobs.what: s: M3 starts: the camera pushes in on the followed agent

knobs.name: lookIn
knobs.what: s: the push-in has landed (expo ease in)

knobs.name: lookHold
knobs.what: s: the pull-back starts

knobs.name: lookOut
knobs.what: s: the camera is back on the wide split pose (stored key)

knobs.name: tag0
knobs.what: s: the followed agent takes the accent colour and a riding pin (M1)

knobs.name: tag1
knobs.what: s: the followed agent returns to its colour (M1)

knobs.name: tagB0
knobs.what: s: the followed agent is outlined again for the close-up (M3)

knobs.name: tagB1
knobs.what: s: the outline of the close-up ends

knobs.name: tagPin0
knobs.what: s: the pin on the followed agent appears in the close-up (after the push-in settles)

knobs.name: tagPin1
knobs.what: s: the pin on the followed agent leaves

knobs.name: poolPin
knobs.what: s: the pooled ratio pin (+14 %) lands, 4 s after the count

knobs.name: poolOut
knobs.what: s: the pooled pin cuts off before the re-partition

knobs.name: splitPin
knobs.what: s: the split pins start (low and middle appear together)

knobs.name: lowPin
knobs.what: s: the lowest-skill result and the middle label appear

knobs.name: highPin
knobs.what: s: the highest-skill result appears (3 s after the first)

knobs.name: avgLine
knobs.what: s: the pooled average returns as a dashed line across the five fifths

knobs.name: splitOut0
knobs.what: s: the split pins cut off for the push-in (labels never ride a move)

knobs.name: splitBack
knobs.what: s: the split pins cut back on after the settle

knobs.name: splitOut1
knobs.what: s: the split pins cut off before the hard cut

knobs.name: devPin
knobs.what: s: the developers ratio pin (+26 %) lands, 4 s after the count

knobs.name: devPinOut
knobs.what: s: the developers pin leaves before the cut

knobs.name: dots0
knobs.what: s: the 16 developer dots start to land

knobs.name: dots1
knobs.what: s: all 16 developer dots are in

knobs.name: issues0
knobs.what: s: the 246 issue columns start to land

knobs.name: issues1
knobs.what: s: all 246 issue columns are in

knobs.name: devPin0
knobs.what: s: the pin on the followed developer appears

knobs.name: foreAt
knobs.what: s: the forecast result (24 %) appears in the belief view

knobs.name: foreOut
knobs.what: s: the forecast pin and the developer pin cut off before the tilt

knobs.name: frameF0
knobs.what: s: the forecast frame (ghost) appears

knobs.name: frameB0
knobs.what: s: the believed-after frame (ghost) appears

knobs.name: tilt0
knobs.what: s: M2 starts: the camera tilts from plan to the side and the level re-stacks from forecast to measured

knobs.name: tilt1
knobs.what: s: M2 has landed on the side view

knobs.name: measAt
knobs.what: s: the measured result (19 %) appears

knobs.name: beliefAt
knobs.what: s: the believed-after result (20 %) appears, 3 s after the first

knobs.name: devPin1
knobs.what: s: the pin on the followed developer returns in the side view

knobs.name: honestAt
knobs.what: s: the honest-limits line appears on stage

knobs.name: azH
knobs.what: degrees: azimuth of the wide hook frame

knobs.name: elH
knobs.what: degrees: elevation of the wide hook frame

knobs.name: hhH
knobs.what: world units: half-height of the hook frame (larger = wider)

knobs.name: az0
knobs.what: degrees: azimuth of the pooled-wall view (small = the wall seen flat)

knobs.name: el0
knobs.what: degrees: elevation of the pooled-wall view

knobs.name: hhC
knobs.what: world units: half-height of the pooled-wall view

knobs.name: lookYC
knobs.what: 0-1 of the wall height the camera looks at (pooled view)

knobs.name: az1
knobs.what: degrees: azimuth of the split view (about 90 = square on to the row of fifths)

knobs.name: el1
knobs.what: degrees: elevation of the split view (the tilt into 3D)

knobs.name: hhS
knobs.what: world units: half-height of the split view

knobs.name: lookYS
knobs.what: 0-1 of the wall height the camera looks at (split view)

knobs.name: bookLift
knobs.what: world units: how far the bookend lifts the wall up the frame (room for the honest-limits line below it)

knobs.name: hhTag
knobs.what: world units: half-height of the close-up on the followed agent (M3)

knobs.name: azD
knobs.what: degrees: azimuth of the developers view

knobs.name: elD
knobs.what: degrees: elevation of the developers view

knobs.name: hhD
knobs.what: world units: half-height of the developers view

knobs.name: lookYD
knobs.what: 0-1 of the wall height the camera looks at (developers view)

knobs.name: devLookDz
knobs.what: world units: shift of the developers view toward the agents row (positive = more of the row shows)

knobs.name: azM
knobs.what: degrees: azimuth of the METR views (fixed through the tilt)

knobs.name: elBelief
knobs.what: degrees: elevation of the belief view (89 = plan)

knobs.name: elSide
knobs.what: degrees: elevation of the measured view (side elevation)

knobs.name: hhM
knobs.what: world units: half-height of the METR views

knobs.name: metLookX
knobs.what: world units: x of the METR look point (shifts the block up or down the frame in plan)

knobs.name: metLookY
knobs.what: world units: height of the METR look point

knobs.name: orbitAmp
knobs.what: degrees: amplitude of the calm sway (whole film; 0 = still camera)

knobs.name: orbitPeriod
knobs.what: s: period of the calm sway (longer = slower)

knobs.name: boxSize
knobs.what: world units: edge of one worker box

knobs.name: boxGap
knobs.what: world units: seam between boxes

knobs.name: layers
knobs.what: boxes high a wall or fifth is (rate form: lit height = gain on one scale)

knobs.name: slabDepth
knobs.what: boxes deep a skill fifth is

knobs.name: poolDepth
knobs.what: boxes deep the pooled agents wall is

knobs.name: slabGap
knobs.what: world units: aisle between the five fifths

knobs.name: devPoolDepth
knobs.what: boxes along the viewing axis of the developers wall

knobs.name: devZ
knobs.what: world units: where the developers wall stands, to the right of the agents row

knobs.name: gainFull
knobs.what: % gain that would light a whole column (one scale for every agent column; not shown)

knobs.name: gainFullDev
knobs.what: % gain that would light the whole developers wall (its own scale; a different outcome)

knobs.name: arrW
knobs.what: fraction of an arrival clock one box takes to fall and grow into its berth

knobs.name: drop
knobs.what: world units a box falls from as it arrives

knobs.name: stagger
knobs.what: 0-1: how spread out in time the boxes leave the pooled wall (each box keeps its own path)

knobs.name: lift
knobs.what: world units: height of the arc each box makes between its two homes

knobs.name: orderMix
knobs.what: 0 = seeded order, 1 = fifth order (the fifths fill one after another)

knobs.name: metCols
knobs.what: issue columns across the METR block

knobs.name: metPitch
knobs.what: world units: pitch of the issue columns

knobs.name: metW
knobs.what: world units: edge of one issue column

knobs.name: metH
knobs.what: world units: height of the line for time without AI (the baseline frame)

knobs.name: metZ
knobs.what: world units: where the METR block stands, to the right of the developers wall

knobs.name: dotPitch
knobs.what: world units: pitch of the 16 developer dots

knobs.name: dotW
knobs.what: world units: edge of a developer dot

knobs.name: dotH
knobs.what: world units: height of a developer dot

knobs.name: dotGap
knobs.what: world units: distance of the dot row in front of the block

knobs.name: tagDev
knobs.what: which of the 16 developer dots is followed

knobs.name: soloScale
knobs.what: x box size: the lone box of the hook

knobs.name: soloX
knobs.what: world units: x of the lone box (toward the camera is positive)

knobs.name: soloZ
knobs.what: world units: z of the lone box

knobs.name: groundX
knobs.what: world units: width (depth for the camera) of the ledger floor

knobs.name: groundZ0
knobs.what: world units: far edge of the ledger page

knobs.name: groundZ1
knobs.what: world units: near edge of the ledger page

knobs.name: rules
knobs.what: number of ruled lines each side of the centre line (0 = plain floor)

knobs.name: rulePitch
knobs.what: world units: distance between ruled lines

knobs.name: ruleZ0
knobs.what: world units: far end of the ruled lines

knobs.name: ruleZ1
knobs.what: world units: near end of the ruled lines

knobs.name: deckMix
knobs.what: 0-1: ground colour from background (0) to panel (1)

knobs.name: ruleMix
knobs.what: 0-1: rule colour from background toward muted

knobs.name: frameMix
knobs.what: 0-1: baseline frame colour from background toward ink

knobs.name: ghostMix
knobs.what: 0-1: forecast and believed-after frame colour from background toward accent

knobs.name: frameW
knobs.what: line width of the frames

knobs.name: dim
knobs.what: 0-1: how far an unlit box is mixed toward the ground

knobs.name: metDim
knobs.what: 0-1: how far the METR columns below the baseline are mixed toward the ground

knobs.name: dotDim
knobs.what: 0-1: how far the developer dots are mixed toward the ground

knobs.name: ambient
knobs.what: fill light on every face (display-linear multiplier)

knobs.name: keyLight
knobs.what: key light from above-left

knobs.name: rimLight
knobs.what: rim light from behind-right

knobs.name: bgFade
knobs.what: 0-1: how far the agents row dims behind the developers wall

knobs.name: postLevel
knobs.what: gl-post level: exec = tone map only; manager adds bloom and vignette

knobs.name: bloomGain
knobs.what: bloom strength on the measured top (0 = off)

knobs.name: bloom0
knobs.what: s: bloom starts to rise (before the measured result)

knobs.name: bloom1
knobs.what: s: bloom at full gain

knobs.name: bloom2
knobs.what: s: bloom starts to fall

knobs.name: bloom3
knobs.what: s: bloom off

knobs.name: vignetteGain
knobs.what: corner darkening, the whole film

knobs.name: exposure
knobs.what: pre-tonemap exposure

knobs.name: bookExposure
knobs.what: exposure of the MONDAY bookend (the wall under the honest line)

knobs.name: pinLift
knobs.what: world units: a pin anchor above its roof

knobs.name: pinSize
knobs.what: sheet units: split result type (result floor 28)

knobs.name: poolPinSize
knobs.what: sheet units: pooled and METR result type (result floor 28)

knobs.name: plate
knobs.what: 0-1: opacity of the dark plate behind a pin text

knobs.name: dispAdv
knobs.what: em: average advance of the display face, for label boxes

knobs.name: readSize
knobs.what: sheet units: the count readout (must-read)

knobs.name: readDim
knobs.what: opacity of the agents readout once the re-partition starts

knobs.name: hold
knobs.what: frames a label must be pushed before it hides (gl-labels hysteresis)

knobs.name: leader
knobs.what: sheet units: leader length of a pin

knobs.name: maxShown
knobs.what: label budget per frame

knobs.name: bracketLift
knobs.what: world units: bracket and middle-label anchor above the roofs

knobs.name: avgPad
knobs.what: world units: how far the average line overhangs the first and last fifth

knobs.name: legendY
knobs.what: sheet units: y of the legend line (above the caption band)

knobs.name: capTop
knobs.what: sheet units: top of the reserved caption band (labels never enter it)

knobs.name: hookSize
knobs.what: sheet units: the word AI over the hook outline

knobs.name: honestY
knobs.what: sheet units: y of the first line of the honest-limits line

knobs.name: honestSize
knobs.what: sheet units: the honest-limits line (secondary)

knobs.name: honestW
knobs.what: sheet units: wrap width of the honest-limits line
